pattern: as long as {c:Cond} , {o:Obj} has all activated abilities of ( all | each ) {f:Filter}

examples.text: As long as you control a Swamp, ~ has all activated abilities of all artifact cards in all graveyards.
As long as it's your turn, ~ has all activated abilities of each creature card in your graveyard.

counterExamples: As long as you control a Swamp, ~ has all triggered abilities of all artifact cards in all graveyards.

pattern: as long as the top card of your library is ( a | an ) {f:Filter} , {o:Obj} has all activated abilities of that card

examples.text: As long as the top card of your library is a Dragon card, ~ has all activated abilities of that card.
As long as the top card of your library is an artifact card, ~ has all activated abilities of that card.

counterExamples: As long as the top card of your library is a Dragon card, ~ has all triggered abilities of that card.
As long as the top card of an opponent's library is a Dragon card, ~ has all activated abilities of that card.

pattern: {p:Player} mill[s] x cards , where x is the number of cards put into their graveyard from anywhere this turn
subject: player

examples.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, enchanted player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards put into their graveyard from anywhere this turn.
When ~ enters, target player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards put into their graveyard from anywhere this turn.

counterExamples: At the beginning of your upkeep, enchanted player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards put into your graveyard from anywhere this turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, enchanted player mills X cards, where X is the number of cards put into their graveyard from the battlefield this turn.

pattern: ( when | whenever ) ~ deals combat damage to a player {c:Cond}

examples.text: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player who controls more artifacts than you, draw a card.
When ~ deals combat damage to a player who controls more creatures than you, you gain 2 life.

counterExamples: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player who controls fewer artifacts than you, draw a card.
Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player who controls more artifacts than each other player, draw a card.
